about.text: Milk heated in its sealed bottle or can to around 110–120 °C for 20 minutes or more, which kills everything in it and lets it keep for months unopened without cooling. The long heating browns it slightly and gives it a cooked, caramel taste.

picture.file: Sterilised milk. Don't remember seeing this in a bottle since the 1970s #oldgit
picture.author: Lloyd Davis

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The milk is filled and sealed first, then the whole bottle is heated for many minutes. That long heat makes it keep for about a year, but destroys more of the vitamins.
